svg.title: Prevent Forest Fires - finalized British Columbia Forest Branch sign
svg.desc: Final clean vector recreation from the supplied photograph, with individually editable outlined lettering, an estimated perspective correction, and a completed symmetric oval. No external fonts or raster artwork.
svg.metadata: {"title": "Prevent Forest Fires - finalized vector reconstruction", "revision": "final-2026-11-20", "source_image": "162329664_1293389484388412_4101552624557463600_n.jpg", "canvas": [1440, 880], "palette": {"yellow": "#E4D02B", "red": "#851820", "footer": "#A36C23"}, "method": "Custom reconstructed display and supporting bold lettering, outlined footer, one shared conditional perspective correction, and a completed symmetric oval.", "source_to_final_homography": [[1.0906355862516515, 0.10250270960285793, -40.03422520057826], [0.0028155581373793094, 1.1545354589891361, -248.0235984536855], [3.3818629995572057e-07, 0.00013867519546466913, 1.0]], "geometry": "The original reconstructed Bezier outlines were transformed directly; projective curves are represented as editable cubic Beziers, not raster traces.", "curve_approximation_tolerance_artwork_units": 0.006, "text_outlined": true, "font_files_required": false, "raster_images_embedded": false, "uncertainties": ["Original fonts are unconfirmed; candidate font research informs but does not replace the reconstructed shapes.", "Perspective correction is inferred from the lettering, not calibrated camera geometry.", "Physical original dimensions/aspect and exact print colours remain unknown.", "Tiny CAMPFIRES A counter and footer period after BRANCH are faint in the source."], "wording": ["PREVENT FOREST FIRES", "WHEN IN THE WOODS", "PUT", "YOUR", "CAMPFIRES", "OUT", "DO NOT DROP", "LIGHTED MATCHES OR TOBACCO", "PRESENTED BY FOREST BRANCH. LANDS DEPT. VICTORIA B.C."], "source_components": ["work/finalization/display_review/top_lettering_refined.svg", "work/finalization/small_lettering_final.svg", "work/main_lettering.svg", "work/middle_lettering.svg", "work/lower_lettering.svg"]}
